title: Roast Beef with Diced Vegetables
recipeIngredients: 1/2 	celeriac, peeled and diced; 2 	parsnips, peeled and diced; 3 	carrots, peeled and diced; 2 	potatoes, peeled and diced; 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil; 1 	cross rib roast 2.5 lb (1.2 kg), deboned and tied with the bones; 2 tbsp 	(30 ml) Dijon mustard; 12 	garlic cloves, unpeeled; 1 tsp 	(5 ml) honey; 3/4 cup (180 ml) red wine; 1 tbsp 	(15 ml) whole-grain mustard; 1/3 cup (75 ml) beef broth
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 325°F (165°C).; In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the vegetables in half the oil (2 tbsp/30 ml). Season with salt and pepper. Transfer the vegetables to a plate and set aside.; In the same skillet, brown the roast on all sides in the remaining oil, then place on a baking sheet. Set the skillet aside to reserve the cooking juices for the sauce. Brush the roast with the Dijon mustard. Season with salt and pepper. Add the vegetables and garlic cloves to the pan. Bake for 50 minutes or until a thermometer inserted in the meat reads 122°F (50 °C).; Remove the roast from the oven and transfer the meat to a platter. Cover with aluminum foil and let rest  for 10 minutes. Peel and purée the garlic cloves. Set aside. Keep the vegetables in the oven (turned off) while you prepare the sauce. ; Pour the honey into the reserved skillet over high heat. Deglaze with the wine and let reduce by half. Add the mustard, puréed garlic and broth. Cook for 1 minute while stirring. Add a little broth if needed.; Remove the butcher’s twine and the bones from the roast. On a work surface, thinly slice against the grain. Serve with the vegetables and sauce.

title: Apple and Cheddar Burgers
recipeIngredients: 1 lb (454 g) medium ground beef, pork or veal; 1/2 cup (125 ml) unsweetened applesauce; 1/2 cup (125 ml) fresh breadcrumbs; 1 egg; 1 cup (250 ml) grated sharp cheddar; Salt and pepper; 4 large kaiser rolls or hamburger buns; Dijon mustard; Mayonnaise; 1 green or Cortland apple, chopped; 2 green onions, finely chopped; Boston lettuce
recipeInstructions: Preheat the grill, setting the burners to medium-high. Oil the grate.; In a bowl, combine the meat, applesauce, breadcrumbs, egg and cheddar. Season with salt and pepper. Shape four 12.5-cm (5-inch) in diameter patties. ; Grill until well done, about 5 minutes per side. Toast the rolls on the grill.; Spread the rolls with mustard and mayonnaise. Place a patty on each roll. Garnish with apple, green onion and lettuce.

; Preheat the grill, setting the burners on high. Oil the grate.; Thread the beef onto the skewers alternating with pieces of bell pepper.; Grill to your desired doneness, turning occasionally. Count 7 to 8 minutes

title: Herb-Crusted Prime Rib Roast
recipeIngredients: 1/2 cup (23 g) chopped mixed fresh herbs (parsley, chives, thyme, etc.); 2  cloves garlic, finely chopped; 2 tbsp sea salt or coarse salt; 1 tbsp mixed peppercorns, crushed; 1  bone-in beef prime rib roast, about 2 1/2 to 3 lb  (1.3 to 1.5 kg)
recipeInstructions:

Oil the unheated side of the grate.; Place the beef on a plate and sprinkle with the herb mixture. Reserve 2 tbsp for garnish. tent with aluminum foil and let rest for 10 to 15 minutes.; Remove the bone and slice.

title: Todoroki Beef
recipeIngredients: 2.2 lb  (1 kg) strip loin steaks, about 1 inch (2.5 cm) thick,  at room temperature; 6 tbsp (90 ml) untoasted sesame oil; 6 tbsp (90 ml) balsamic vinegar; 2 tbsp (30 ml) Worcestershire sauce; 1/4 cup (60 ml) honey; 4 green onions, finely chopped; 4 garlic cloves, finely chopped; Salt and pepper; Arugula and lime, for garnish
recipeInstructions:
Preheat the grill, setting the burners to high. Oil the grate.; Trim visible fat from the beef. Grill for about 3 minutes 
on each side for rare meat, or until the desired doneness.

Cover the dish or seal the bag. Refrigerate for 8 hours. 
Turn occasionally.; Cut the steaks into thin strips. Arrange on a plate, garnish with arugula and drizzle with the marinade. Serve with lime wedges, if desired.

title: Slow-Cooker Beef Stroganoff
recipeIngredients: 1 1/2 lb (675 g) beef sirloin; 1/4 cup (60 ml) flour; 3 tablespoons (45 ml) oil; Salt and pepper; 2 onions, chopped; 3 tablespoons (45 ml) butter; 3 cups (750 ml) sliced mushrooms; 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped; 1/2 cup (125 ml) red wine; 1 cup (250 ml) beef broth; 1/2 teaspoon (2.5 ml) paprika; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) Dijon mustard ; 3/4 cup (180 ml) plain yogurt; Fresh parsley, chopped; Fresh chives, chopped
recipeInstructions: Cut the sirloin into 1-cm (1/2-inch) wide strips against the grain of the meat.; Dust the meat pieces with flour and brown in a skillet over high heat in the oil, a little at a time. Season with salt and pepper. Place into the slow cooker.; In the same skillet, brown the onions in the butter. Add the mushrooms, garlic and cook for 5 minutes over high heat. Season with salt and pepper.; Deglaze with the wine and pour into the slow cooker. Add the remaining ingredients except for the yogurt and parsley or chives.; Cover and cook on high heat for about 2 hours, or low heat for 4 to 5 hours, approximately.; Add the yogurt and adjust the seasoning. Do not boil.; Sprinkle with parsley or chives and serve with egg noodles.

title: Beef “Taliata”

Drizzle with the balsamic reduction and serve with Mashed Potatoes with Olive Oil.

title: Chop Suey

title: Crispy Orange Beef
recipeIngredients: Peanut oil, for frying; 3/4 cup (180 ml) all-purpose flour; 3/4 teaspoon (4 ml) five-spice; 1/2 teaspoon (2.5 ml) salt; 1 1/4 lb (600 g) sliced fondue beef, cut into 3-inch (7.5-cm) strips; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) cornstarch; 1/2 cup (125 ml) beef broth; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) toasted sesame oil; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) peanut oil; 1 red bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch (1-cm) cubes; 2 green onions, chopped; 3 cloves garlic, finely chopped; Grated zest and juice of 1 large orange; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) fresh ginger, grated; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) oyster sauce; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) sesame seeds, toasted

Add the orange zest and juice, ginger and oyster sauce.; Bring to a boil. Add the cornstarch mixture and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Adjust the seasoning. Add the beef and stir to coat.; At service, sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve with white rice.

title: Tex-Mex Tortilla Cake
recipeIngredients: 4 green onions, chopped; 2 garlic cloves, chopped; 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 1 lb (454 g) lean ground beef; 1 tsp dried oregano; 1 tbsp chili powder; 1 block (250 g) cream cheese, softened; 1/4 cup (60 ml) chicken broth; 2 tbsp fresh chives, finely chopped; 5 wheat tortillas, about 8 inches (20 cm) in diameter; 2 cups (200 g) sharp cheddar cheese, grated; Salsa, for serving; Sour cream, for serving
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180 °C).; In a saucepan over medium-high heat, sauté the green onions and garlic in the oil. Add the beef and cook over high heat,  breaking it up with a wooden spoon. Add the oregano, chili powder, cream cheese, chicken broth and chives. Cook, stirring, until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside.; Place a tortilla in a large pie plate. Cover with about one-fifth of the meat mixture. Sprinkle with one-fifth of the cheese. Repeat, alternating tortilla, meat, and cheese until all the ingredients have been used. Top with cheese. Cover the tortilla cake with a sheet of foil.; Bake for 20 minutes. Remove the foil and continue cooking for another 20 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting into wedges. Serve with salsa and sour cream, to taste.

title: Soft-Boiled Eggs with French Toast “Soldiers”
recipeIngredients: 3 eggs  ; 3 tbsp (45 ml) milk; 3/4 cup (95 g) breadcrumbs; 3/4 cup (55 g) fresh Parmesan cheese, finely grated; 4 slices day-old square bread, cut into sticks ½ inch (1.5 cm) thick ; 1/4 cup (55 g) butter; 8 eggs, at room temperature; 12 large asparagus, roasted
recipeInstructions:
In a shallow dish, lightly whisk the eggs with the milk. In a second shallow dish, combine the breadcrumbs and Parmesan.


; Dip the sticks of bread into the egg mixture, letting some of the excess drip off. Press into the breadcrumb mixture to coat well.; In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, brown half of the breadsticks at a time in half of the butter (2 tbsp) for 1 to 2 minutes on each side or until nicely browned. Drain on a plate lined with paper towels.; In a pot of simmering water, gently lower the eggs using a slotted spoon. Cook for 3 minutes. Using the slotted spoon, remove the eggs from the water. Place in eggcups. Using a knife or the back of a spoon, hit the tops of the eggs and remove.; Serve the eggs with the breadsticks and asparagus.
description: Let’s face it, the best part of soft-boiled eggs are the little “soldiers” of bread that you dip headfirst into the runny yolks. We’re taking things up a notch with mini savoury French toast breadsticks coated in Parmesan breadcrumbs. In this recipe, even asparagus serves as the perfect tool for dipping!

title: Chocolate, Honey and Cranberry Granola
recipeIngredients: 3/4 cup (180 ml) honey; 2 tbsp (30 ml) water; 6 tbsp (85 g) butter; 1/4 cup (25 g) cocoa; 3 cups (300 g) large-flake oats; 1 pinch salt; 3/4 cup (115 g) dried cranberries; 3/4 cup (120 g) roasted pumpkin seeds; 3 oz (85 g) dark chocolate, chopped
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.; In a large pot over low heat, stir the honey and water with the butter and cocoa until the butter is melted. Remove from the heat.; Add the oats to the pot and stir to coat with the honey mixture. Spread the oat mixture out on the baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt.; Bake for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Let cool completely, about 1 hour.; Add the cranberries and pumpkin seeds to the granola. Delicious drizzled with more honey. Serve over plain yogurt, if desired. The granola will keep for 1 month in an airtight container at room temperature.
description: Start your day with a delicious mix of cocoa-coated oats, dried cranberries and pumpkin seeds. Lightly sweetened with local honey and dark chocolate, this granola provides an effortless boost of energy.

title: Laura Beaulé’s Pistachio Croissants
recipeIngredients: 2/3 cup (150 ml) maple syrup; 2/3 cup (150 ml) water; 1 orange, zest finely grated; 1 cup (130 g) unsalted raw shelled pistachios; 1/2 cup (115 g) unsalted butter, softened; 1/2 cup (105 g) sugar ; 2 eggs, at room temperature; 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla; 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) almond extract ; 1/4 tsp salt; 6 day-old croissants; 3 tbsp unsalted raw shelled pistachios, chopped; Icing sugar, for sprinkling
recipeInstructions: In a small pot, bring the maple syrup and water to a boil. Remove from the heat. Add the orange zest and mix well. Set aside (see note).; With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.; In a food processor, blend the pistachios for 2 minutes to a very fine texture.; In a large bowl, beat the butter and sugar with an electric mixer for 2 to 3 minutes or until pale and creamy. Add the eggs, vanilla, almond extract and salt. Mix until smooth. Gradually stir in the blended pistachios.; Set 6 tbsp (90 ml) of the pistachio paste aside in a small bowl. ; On a work surface, using a breadknife, cut the croissants in half horizontally without going all the way through to the other side.; Using a pastry brush, cover the insides of the croissants with some of the syrup. Divide the remaining pistachio paste among the croissants bottoms, about 2 to 3 tbsp per croissant. Close the croissants and transfer to the baking sheet. Brush the surface of the croissants with more of the syrup. Spread the reserved pistachio paste over the tops of the croissants, about 1 tbsp per croissant. Sprinkle with the chopped pistachios.; Bake for 15 minutes or until the croissants are golden.; Let cool for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with icing sugar.
description: These pistachio croissants by Laura Beaulé, creator of the website Dash of Honey, are full of sweet indulgence. They're brushed with a syrup made of maple and orange and filled with homemade pistachio paste. Baked until golden brown, they're a decadent treat perfect for brunch.

title: Breakfast Poutine
recipeIngredients: 1 3/4 lb (800 g) yellow-fleshed red potatoes, unpeeled, cut into sticks ½ inch (1 cm) thick (about 6 potatoes) ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) vegetable oil; 2 fresh chorizo sausages, cut into pieces (about 1/3 lb/150 g); Eggs 2 tbsp (30 ml) white vinegar; 2 eggs; 2 tbsp butter ; 2 tbsp unbleached all-purpose flour ; 1 can (284 ml) condensed chicken both ; 1/2 cup (125 ml) 15% cooking cream; 2 egg yolks ; 7 oz (200 g) cheese curds ; 1 tbsp chives, finely chopped
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the lowest position, preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.; Place the potatoes in a strainer and rinse under cold running water. Dry with a clean dishcloth. On the baking sheet, toss the potatoes with the oil. Season with salt.; Bake for 30 minutes or until starting to brown. Stir. Add the sausages and continue to bake for 10 minutes. Keep warm.; In a pot of salted simmering water, add the vinegar. Break the eggs, one at a time, into a saucer and gently slide into the water. Poach for 3 minutes or until the desired doneness. The yolks should stay runny. Drain the poached eggs on a plate lined with paper towels. ; Meanwhile, in a small pot over medium heat, melt the butter until foaming. Add the flour and whisk for 1 minute. Gradually add the broth, stirring constantly, until smooth. Add the cream. Bring to a boil while stirring constantly. Simmer for 3 minutes. Remove from the heat.; Stir the egg yolks into the sauce. Season generously with pepper. Keep warm as needed (see note).; Divide the potatoes, sausages and cheese between two shallow bowls. Cover with the hot sauce. Top each poutine with a poached egg and sprinkle with the chives.
description: This hearty breakfast includes golden potato fries, chorizo, creamy sauce, a poached egg, and cheese curds, bringing the essence of poutine to your morning menu.

title: Cereal-Crusted French Toast Rolls
recipeIngredients: 1/3 cup (75 g) unsalted butter, softened; 3 tbsp brown sugar ; 1 tsp ground cinnamon ; 8 slices white bread; 1 egg; 1/4 cup (60 ml) milk; 1 cup (30 g) mixed cereal (see note); Maple syrup, for serving
recipeInstructions: In a small bowl, combine 3 tbsp of the butter, the brown sugar and cinnamon with a fork until the texture is spreadable. ; On a work surface, cut the crusts off the bread. Save the crusts for another use (for example: breadcrumbs). Using a rolling pin, flatten the slices of bread.; Spread the butter mixture over the flattened bread. Roll the slices up into logs. Set aside on a plate.; In a shallow dish, combine the egg and milk with a fork. In a second shallow dish, coarsely crush the cereal.; Dip 1 French toast roll at a time in the egg mixture, letting some of the excess drip off. Gently press into the cereal to coat well. ; In a large non-stick skillet over medium heat, cook the rolls in the remaining butter, turning them over regularly, until nicely browned. description: This recipe for cereal-crusted French toast rolls is easy to prepare and fun for kids. title: Giant Almond and Spice Croissant
recipeIngredients: 1 sheet (200 g) store-bought puff pastry, thawed, cold; 1/2 cup (115 g) unsalted butter, softened; 1/2 cup (105 g) sugar; 2 eggs; 1 cup (130 g) ground almonds ; 1/4 tsp salt ; 1/4 tsp ground ginger ; 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon ; 1 pinch ground cloves; 1 pinch ground nutmeg; 1 pinch ground black pepper ; 1/3 cup (70 g) dark chocolate chips (optional); 1/3 cup (35 g) sliced almonds; Icing sugar, for sprinkling
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.; On a floured work surface, roll the puff pastry out to form a 10-inch (25 cm) square (see note). Place on the baking sheet.; Bake for 20 minutes or until the pastry is cooked and is starting to brown. The pastry will puff up. Let cool on the baking sheet, about 15 minutes. The cooked puff pastry will keep for 1 day at room temperature.; Meanwhile, in a bowl, whisk together the butter and sugar. Add the eggs one at a time and mix until smooth. Stir in the ground almonds, salt, spices and pepper until combined (see note). Set aside.; On a work surface, using a bread knife, cut the puff pastry in half horizontally into two layers.; Spread 1 1/2 cups (375 ml) of the almond cream over the bottom layer of pastry to cover the entire surface. Sprinkle with the chocolate chips. Close with the top layer of pastry. Gently cover the top of the pastry with the remaining almond cream, being careful not to crush it. Do not worry if the pastry is very rounded, it will flatten out during cooking. Sprinkle with the sliced almonds.; Continue to bake the croissant for 25 to 30 minutes or until the almond cream is cooked. Let cool for 15 minutes. Lightly sprinkle with icing sugar. Cut into pieces.
description: For brunch, what could be better than a giant flaky croissant that can be shared with loved ones? Try this ultra indulgent version that can be prepared one day and enjoyed the next. Use store-bought puff pastry on which you spread some spiced almond cream and chocolate chips. This recipe will surely have you forgetting about the bakery down the street.

title: Mushroom, Leek and Goat Cheese Crustless Quiche
recipeIngredients: 1/2 lb (225 g) cremini or white mushrooms, quartered ; 1/4 cup (55 g) butter; 1 leek, cut into pieces 3/4 inch (2 cm) long; 8 eggs; 1 cup (250 ml) 15% cooking cream; 3 1/2 oz (100 g) fresh goat cheese, crumbled	; 1/4 cup (10 g) flat-leaf parsley leaves
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).; In a 10-inch (25 cm) cast iron skillet over medium-high heat, brown the mushrooms in half of the butter (2 tbsp). Season with salt and pepper. Set aside on a plate.; In the same skillet over medium heat, melt the remaining butter. Add the leek, cut-sides down, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes on both sides or until golden. Season with salt and pepper. Set the leek aside on the plate of mushrooms. Clean out the skillet.; Spread the vegetables out in the skillet.; In a bowl, whisk together the eggs and cream. Season with salt and pepper. Gently pour the egg mixture into the skillet. Add two-thirds of the cheese.; Bake in the oven for 25 minutes or until the centre of the quiche is just set. Top with the remaining cheese and the parsley leaves.
description: For a family brunch or a quick dinner, this simple recipe is ideal. For this quiche, there’s no need to roll out dough. Simply fill the egg mixture with mushrooms, leeks and crumbled goat cheese for a hearty meal.

title: Hash Brown Potatoes
recipeIngredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) russet potatoes, peeled or not, scrubbed clean and cubed (about 5 to 6 large potatoes) ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) lemon juice (see note); 1 large onion, chopped; ¼ cup (60 ml) vegetable oil; 1 garlic clove, chopped; 3 tbsp butter ; 2 tsp sweet paprika ; 2 tsp dried oregano
recipeInstructions: Place the potatoes in a large pot. Cover with cold water and season with salt. Bring to a boil. Add the lemon juice and cook for 5 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked but not completely tender. Drain. Rinse under cold running water and drain well. Spread out on a baking sheet or place in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes or overnight.; In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, brown the onion in 2 tbsp (30 ml) of the oil. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute while stirring. Set aside in a small bowl.; In the same skillet over high heat, warm the remaining oil with the butter. Add the potatoes and cook for 15 minutes, stirring every 2 to 3 minutes, or until golden. Add the onion mixture, paprika and oregano. Continue to cook for 2 minutes while stirring. Season generously with salt and pepper. Mix well. Transfer the potatoes to a serving bowl. Serve immediately.
description: No brunch is complete without a side of hash brown potatoes. There’s no need to sweat it since all you have to do is chop up some russet potatoes, blanch them (either the night before or the morning of), and sauté them with onions and spices.

title: Caramelized French Toast with Roasted Strawberries
recipeIngredients: 2 cups (280 g) fresh strawberries, halved or quartered; 3 tbsp (45 ml) maple syrup ; 1 orange, zest finely grated; 3 eggs; 1 cup (250 ml) milk; 1/2 cup (105 g) brown sugar; 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon ; 1 brioche loaf, about 1 lb (400 g to 450 g), cut into 4 thick slices (see note) ; 1/4 cup (55 g) unsalted butter ; 1/2 cup (125 ml) 35% whipping cream; 1/2 cup (125 ml) plain Greek yogurt ; 1 1/2 cups (210 g) fresh strawberries, halved or quartered
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).; In a 9 x 5-inch (23 x 13 cm) baking dish, combine the strawberries with the maple syrup and orange zest.; Bake for 20 minutes or until the strawberries are roasted and the cooking juices are thick and syrupy. The roasted strawberries will keep for 2 weeks in an airtight container in the refrigerator.; Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.; In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, ¼ cup (55 g) of the brown sugar and the cinnamon.; Dip one slice of bread at a time in the egg mixture, letting it soak on both sides. Place the bread on the baking sheet as you go.; In a non-stick skillet over medium heat, cook 2 slices of bread in 1 tbsp of the butter until nicely browned on both sides. Set aside on the baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining 2 slices of bread and another 1 tbsp of butter.; In the same skillet over medium-low heat, melt 2 tbsp of the brown sugar with 1 tbsp of the butter. Add 2 slices of bread to the skillet and coat in the brown sugar mixture on both sides. Continue to cook for 1 minute on each side or until a caramel forms on the surface of the bread. Set aside on the baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining brown sugar, butter and 2 slices of bread.; Transfer the baking sheet to the oven and bake the French toast for 7 to 8 minutes or until slightly puffy.; Meanwhile, in a bowl, whisk the 35% cream with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. Using a spatula, fold in the yogurt.; Divide the French toast among four plates. Top with the yogurt whipped cream, fresh strawberries and roasted strawberries. Drizzle with the strawberry cooking syrup.
description: Pay homage to warm summer days with this decadent French toast recipe. Opt for a caramelized brioche on which you add strawberries cooked with maple syrup and orange zest. You can even make the strawberry topping the night before and simply warm it before it hits the table. Add some yogurt whipped cream as a final touch and your fruit-filled breakfast is served.

title: Mushroom Omelette with Herbed Bread Crumbs
recipeIngredients: 1 lb (450 g) whole white mushrooms; 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil; 10 eggs; 1 tbsp butter; 1 garlic clove, chopped; 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil; 1/4 cup (10 g) chopped parsley; 1 tbsp chopped chives; 4 slices dried baguette, toasted and crumbled; 3 tbsp (15 g) freshly grated Parmesan cheese
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).; In an 11-inch (28 cm) non-stick, ovenproof skillet over medium heat, cook the mushrooms in the oil until tender and golden brown, about 12 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Drain on paper towels. Wipe the skillet clean.; Meanwhile, in a bowl, whisk the eggs and season with salt and pepper.; In the same skillet used for the mushrooms, melt the butter over medium heat. Pour in the eggs and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, breaking up the egg that has cooked and allowing the raw egg to run underneath. Top with the mushrooms.; Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 15 minutes or until the omelette is cooked through.; Meanwhile, in a small skillet over medium heat, brown the garlic in the oil. Add the herbs and cook for 1 minute. Add the crumbled baguette and stir to combine.; Slide the omelette onto a serving platter. Sprinkle with the Parmesan and bread crumbs.

title: Sweet and Savoury Dutch Baby Pancake
recipeIngredients: 4	eggs; 1 tbsp sugar ; ½ tsp (2.5 ml) sweet clover extract or ¼ tsp (1 ml) vanilla	; ¼ tsp salt ; ⅔ cup (100 g) unbleached all-purpose flour, sifted ; ⅔ cup (150 ml) milk; 2 tbsp unsalted butter ; 3 tbsp (45 ml) honey ; 3	small peaches, ripe but firm, pitted and cut into wedges, wedges halved ; 3	figs, stems removed, cut into slices lengthwise ; ½ cup (125 ml) ricotta cheese; 6	slices prosciutto, torn in half; 2 tbsp roasted thinly sliced almonds ; Icing sugar, for dusting; A few lemon balm leaves
recipeInstructions: Place a 9-inch (23 cm) cast iron skillet on the middle rack of the oven. Add the figs and stir to coat in the hot honey.; Using a 1-tbsp (15 ml) ice cream scoop, form the ricotta into balls and place on the hot pancake. Top with the fruit and prosciutto. title: Crepes with Berries and Chocolate Sauce
recipeIngredients: ¾ cup (115 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 2 tbsp sugar ; 1	pinch salt; 2	eggs; 1 ¼ cups (310 ml) milk; 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla; 2 tbsp butter, melted, plus more for cooking; 2 cups (300 g) fresh berries (such as blueberries, strawberries, raspberries, blackberries) ; 5 oz (140 g) milk chocolate, chopped; ⅓ cup (75 ml) milk
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine the flour, sugar and salt. Add the eggs, ½ cup (125 ml) of the milk and the vanilla. Whisk until smooth. Gradually whisk in the remaining milk. Stir in the melted butter.; Heat a 9 ½-inch (24 cm) non-stick skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, brush with butter.; For each crepe, pour about ¼ cup (60 ml) of the batter into the centre of the skillet. Tilt the skillet from side to side to spread the batter evenly to cover the entire bottom of the skillet. Once the edge of the crepe easily comes away from the skillet and starts to brown, flip over using a spatula. Cook for another 30 seconds to brown slightly and remove from the skillet. Cover the crepes with foil to prevent from drying out and to keep warm.; In a glass bowl, over a pot of simmering water or in the microwave oven, melt the chocolate with the milk. Whisk until smooth.; Roll up the crepes and divide among four plates. Drizzle with the chocolate sauce and top with the berries.

title: Peanut Butter and Jam French Toast Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 2	eggs; ½ cup (125 ml) milk; 2 tbsp sugar ; 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla ; ½ tsp ground cinnamon ; 8	slices white sandwich bread ; ¼ cup (60 ml) strawberry or raspberry jam ; ¼ cup (60 ml) peanut butter ; 2 tbsp butter ; Maple syrup, for serving

Close the sandwiches.; Dip one sandwich at a time in the egg mixture, letting it soak in. Place the sandwiches on a plate while you prepare to cook them.; Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-low heat. Melt half of the butter in the skillet. Place two sandwiches at a time in the skillet and brown for 2 minutes on each side, flipping them over with a spatula. title: Poached Eggs in Indian-Style Tomato Sauce
recipeIngredients: 2 medium potatoes, peeled and diced; 1 red onion, finely chopped; 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 3 garlic cloves, finely chopped; 1 bird’s eye chili pepper, seeded or not, thinly sliced (optional) ; 4 tsp curry powder ; 2 tsp fresh ginger, finely grated ; 1 tsp sweet paprika ; 1 tsp ground cumin ; 3/4 cup (180 ml) low-sodium or homemade vegetable broth ; 1 can (28 oz/796 ml) diced tomatoes; 1 cup (120 g) green beans, trimmed; 4 to 6 eggs ; 1/3 cup (75 ml) plain yogurt; 1/3 cup (10 g) cilantro leaves
recipeInstructions: In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, soften the potatoes and two-thirds of the onion in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, half of the chili pepper, the curry powder, ginger, paprika and cumin. Cook for 1 minute while stirring. ; Deglaze with the broth. Stir in the tomatoes. Bring to a boil. Simmer for 25 minutes or until the sauce has thickened. Season with salt and pepper.; Arrange the green beans over the sauce. Using a spoon, make 4 to 6 wells in the sauce. Crack an egg into each well. Cover and simmer gently for 6 minutes or until the green beans and egg whites are cooked. Remove from the heat.; Garnish with the yogurt and cilantro leaves. Sprinkle with the remaining red onion and chili pepper. Serve in shallow bowls with naan bread or chapatis, if desired.
description: This vegetarian recipe, inspired by Middle Eastern shakshuka, is a dish consisting of eggs poached in a tomato sauce, which we've adapted by adding Indian spices such as curry, cumin and ginger. For an even heartier meal that can be eaten from brunch to dinner, be sure to add some diced potatoes. It's a meal that can be prepared using whatever you might have in the pantry or refrigerator.

title: Chocolate-Hazelnut Oatmeal
recipeIngredients: 1/3 cup (35 g) quick-cooking oats; 2/3 cup (150 ml) unsweetened oat beverage ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) maple syrup, plus more for serving; 1 tbsp (15 ml) hazelnut butter (see note), plus more for serving ; 2 dates, pitted and diced ; 1 tbsp roasted blanched (peeled) hazelnuts, chopped ; 1 tbsp milk chocolate, coarsely chopped ; 1 pinch ground cinnamon (optional)
recipeInstructions: In a small pot, bring the oats, oat beverage, maple syrup and hazelnut butter to a boil while stirring constantly. Simmer over low heat for 1 minute. Remove from the heat and let rest for 2 minutes. Adjust the consistency by adding more oat beverage as needed.; Transfer the oatmeal to a bowl. Top with the dates, hazelnuts, chocolate and more hazelnut butter. Drizzle with more maple syrup and sprinkle with cinnamon.
description: Start the day with a full stomach with this warm cereal recipe, a true dose of comfort. title: Smoothie Bowl with Caramelized Cereal
recipeIngredients: 6 tbsp (90 ml) maple syrup; 3 tbsp (45 ml) vegetable oil; 1/2 tsp ground ginger ; 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) vanilla; 1 cup (100 g) large-flake oats; 1 cup (30 g) crispy rice cereal (Rice Krispies-style); 1 cup (30 g) cornflake cereal (Corn Flakes-style); 1/4 cup (30 g) unsweetened shredded coconut ; 1 cup (145 g) frozen pineapple cubes; 1 cup (140 g) frozen mango cubes; 3/4 cup (180 ml) unsweetened oat beverage (see note) ; Fresh strawberries, sliced, to taste; Fresh raspberries, to taste

Top with fresh fruit and caramelized cereal, to taste.
description: This recipe plays with texture and brings a boost of energy in the early hours of the day. The vibrant pineapple and mango smoothie is combined with unsweetened oat milk for creaminess. title: Air Fryer Bagels
recipeIngredients: 1 cup (150 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 tsp baking powder ; 1 tsp sugar; 1/2 tsp salt ; 1/4 tsp baking soda ; 1 cup (250 ml) 2% plain Greek yogurt ; 3 tbsp sesame seeds ; 1 egg, beaten; 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil
recipeInstructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, sugar, salt and baking soda. Stir in the yogurt with a wooden spoon. Once the dough becomes too thick to mix with the spoon, use with your fingertips, then your hands until the dough forms into a smooth ball.; On a lightly floured work surface, cut the dough into 4 equal pieces. Shape each piece into a log 10 inches (25 cm) long. Pinch the two extremities of the log together to shape into a bagel about 4 inches (10 cm) in diameter.; Place the sesame seeds on a small plate.; Using a pastry brush, cover the top of the bagels with the beaten egg. Working with one bagel at a time, flip over into the sesame seeds. Brush the other side with the olive oil.; Place two bagels, oiled-side down, in the basket of an air fryer. Cook for 6 minutes at 375°F (190°C). Flip the bagels over and continue to cook for 5 to 6 minutes or until golden. Repeat with the remaining two bagels. Let the bagels cool before serving. Serve with yogurt and chive spread, if desired.
description: Here’s a bagel recipe that you can cook with your parents during the long holiday. The dough is super easy to work with. You don’t even need a rolling pin. title: Banana, Chocolate and Oatmeal Breakfast Cookies
recipeIngredients: 1 ripe banana; 1 tbsp (15 ml) dairy-free beverage of your choice; 3 tbsp ground flax seeds; 1 tsp chia seeds ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) vegetable oil; 1 tbsp (15 ml) natural almond or peanut butter ; 6 tbsp (40 g) large-flake oats; 1/2 oz (15 g) 70% dark chocolate pieces (see note)
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.; In a bowl, mash the banana with a fork. Add the dairy-free beverage, flax and chia seeds. Mix well. Let rest for 5 minutes.; Add the oil and almond butter to the bowl. Mix well. Add the oats and mix until smooth. Using a spoon, form two thick 5-inch (12.5 cm) round cookies on the baking sheet. Top with the chocolate pieces.; Bake for 22 minutes or until the cookies start to brown around the edges. Let cool on a wire rack. The cookies will keep for 2 days in an airtight container at room temperature.
description: Here’s a recipe to add to your collection to avoid sending your scraps of chia and flax seeds to the compost or forgetting them at the bottom of the pantry. These egg-free, dairy-free, gluten-free and no-sugar-added cookies are perfect for busy mornings.

title: Mushroom and Cheese Crepes
recipeIngredients: 1 tbsp butter; 1 tbsp unbleached all-purpose flour; 3/4 (180 ml) milk; 3oz (85 g) firm ripened cheese or Gruyère cheese, grated; 1/2 lb (225 g) white mushrooms, thinly sliced; 1 tbsp butter ; 1 tsp (5 ml) Worcestershire sauce; 1 tbsp chives, finely chopped ; 4 thin crepes, about 8 inches (20 cm) in diameter, hot (see note)
recipeInstructions: In a pot over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the flour and cook for 1 minute while whisking. Add the milk. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Cook for 2 minutes or until the mixture thickens.; Add 1/4 cup (25 g) of the grated cheese to the pot. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and keep warm.; Meanwhile, in a large skillet over high heat, brown the mushrooms in the butter for 5 minutes without stirring. Add the Worcestershire sauce and cook for 1 minute while stirring. Add the chives. Adjust the seasoning.; For each crepe, spread about 2 tbsp (30 ml) of the béchamel sauce over the upper third of the crepe. Top with a quarter of the mushrooms and a quarter of the remaining cheese. Fold the lower part of the crepe over the filling, then fold the crepe in two. Serve immediately.
description: For brunch or lunch, make stuffed crepes with a creamy béchamel sauce, golden-brown mushrooms and gooey Gruyère. A gorgeous way of serving salty crepes.

title: Banana Chocolate Bread
recipeIngredients: 1 cup (250 ml) very ripe bananas mashed with a fork (about 2 bananas); 1 cup (250 ml) sour cream; 2 cups (300 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 tsp baking soda; 1/4 tsp salt; 2 eggs; 1 1/2 cups (360 g) lightly packed brown sugar; 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) vanilla extract; 1/2 cup (125 ml) canola oil; 3 oz (85 g) dark chocolate, chopped (about 1/2 cup); 2 bananas, cut in half lengthwise; 2 tbsp (30 ml) lemon juice; 2 tbsp sugar
recipeInstructions:
With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Butter two 6-cup (1.5 litre), 10 x 4-inch (25 x 10 cm) loaf pans and line each with a sheet of parchment paper, letting it hang over two sides.; In a bowl, combine the bananas and the sour cream. Set aside.; In another bowl, combine the flour, baking soda and salt. Set aside.
; In a third bowl, beat the eggs, brown sugar and vanilla with an electric mixer until the mixture triples in volume. Add the oil in a thin stream. Stir in the dry ingredients, alternating with the mashed bananas. With a spatula, stir in the chocolate. Spread the batter into the pans.
; Place the banana halves on a plate. Sprinkle with the lemon juice and sugar. Place the banana halves on top of the batter, pushing them in lightly.; Bake for 45 to 50 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the centre of the loaf comes out clean. Let cool completely on a wire rack.
description: Banana Chocolate Bread

title: Quick Ratatouille with Hash Browns
recipeIngredients: 1 onion, cubed; 1 Chinese eggplant, cut into rounds 1/2 inch (1 cm) thick or 1 small eggplant, cut into large dice; 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil; 2 garlic cloves, finely chopped; 2 small zucchini (yellow and green), cut into rounds 1/2 inch (1 cm) thick; 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cubed; 2 cups (280 g) cherry tomatoes; 1/4 cup (60 ml) water; 20 frozen mini hash browns; Thyme leaves, to taste; Oregano leaves, to taste
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).; In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, cook the onion and eggplant in the oil until the eggplant is golden. Season with salt and pepper. Add more oil as needed. Add the garlic, zucchini and bell pepper. Continue to cook for 2 minutes while stirring. Add the tomatoes and water. Partially cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until the tomatoes have burst and the sauce has thickened. Remove the lid and continue to cook for a few minutes as needed until the desired consistency is reached. Adjust the seasoning.; Meanwhile, place the hash browns on a non-stick or parchment paper-lined baking sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until slightly golden, turning them over halfway through cooking (see note).; Divide the hash browns among four plates. Top with the ratatouille. Sprinkle with herbs.
description: We’ve cooked up a quick ratatouille bursting with vegetables and served alongside mini hash browns. Perfect for breakfast any time of the day and easy to prepare, this recipe is sure to get your day off to a good start.

title: Leek, Ham and Mimolette Cheese Strata
recipeIngredients: 8 cups (400 g) bread, torn into 1 ½-inch (4 cm) pieces (such as white or sourdough bread) ; 1 large leek, thinly sliced ; 2 tbsp butter ; 2 garlic cloves, chopped; 1 tbsp thyme leaves ; 1/4 cup (60 ml) white wine ; 3 tbsp flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped, plus more for serving ; 5 eggs; 1 cup (250 ml) milk ; 1/2 cup (125 ml) 35% cream; 6 oz (170 g) sliced white ham; 1 1/2 cups (150 g) mimolette cheese, grated ; Olive oil, for drizzling
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C). ; Spread the bread out in a baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes to dry out the bread. Remove from the oven and set aside. Increase the oven temperature to 375°F (190°C).; Meanwhile, in a 9-inch (23 cm) cast iron skillet over medium heat, cook the leeks in the butter until soft, about 8 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Add the garlic and thyme. Cook for 1 minute while stirring. Deglaze with the wine and let reduce by half. Add the parsley and mix well. Set aside in a bowl.; In a large measuring cup, whisk together the eggs, milk and cream. Season with salt and pepper.; In the same skillet off the heat, spread out half of the bread. Nestle half of the ham slices into the bread, folding the ham over itself slightly. Top with half of the leek mixture and half of the cheese. Repeat layering in the remaining bread, ham, and leek mixture, finishing with the cheese.; Pour the egg mixture into the skillet, pressing down lightly on the bread without crushing it. Drizzle with oil and season generously with pepper. Cover with foil.; Bake for 20 minutes. Remove the foil from the skillet. Increase the oven temperature to 425°F (220°C). Bake for another 15 minutes or until the strata is golden. Garnish with more parsley. Serve with green salad, if desired.
description: In collaboration with Les Fromages d’Europe, this strata is served in the skillet used to cook it, for a charming look that’s both chic and rustic. Serve a generous portion of this dish full of tender leek, moist pieces of bread, ham with perfectly crispy edges and mild mimolette cheese. The cheese stays gooey in the centre of the strata with a golden-brown crust on top. Serve for brunch or even for a weeknight dinner.

title: Vegan Cinnamon Pancakes
recipeIngredients: 2 cups (500 ml) unsweetened oat beverage (see note); 2 tbsp (30 ml) lemon juice; 2 cups (300 g) unbleached all-purpose flour ; 1/4 cup (55 g) sugar; 2 tsp baking powder; 2 tsp ground cinnamon, plus more for serving ; 1 tsp baking soda ; 1/2  tsp salt; 3 tbsp (45 ml) vegetable oil, plus more for cooking ; 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla; 1 cup (130 g) icing sugar ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) unsweetened oat beverage ; 1 tsp (5 ml) lemon juice; 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla; 2 ripe bananas, cut into rounds; Roasted pecans, chopped, to taste
recipeInstructions: In a large measuring cup, combine the oat beverage and lemon juice. Let sit for 5 minutes.; In a large bowl, combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt.; Add the oil and vanilla to the oat beverage mixture. Gradually pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients while whisking just until the batter is smooth (see note).; Warm a large non-stick skillet over medium-low heat. Once the skillet is warm, brush with vegetable oil. Cook 3 pancakes at a time, using 3 tbsp (45 ml) of batter for each one, for 1 to 2 minutes on each side. The pancakes are ready to flip over when bubbles start to form at the centre or when the edges are starting to cook. Adjust the heat as needed to allow the pancakes time to cook before they brown too quickly.; Keep the pancakes warm in an oven preheated to 200°F (95°C) while you cook the remaining batter or serve them as you go.; In a bowl, whisk together the icing sugar, oat beverage, lemon juice and vanilla. Add more oat beverage as needed.; Serve the pancakes on plates drizzled with the icing. Garnish with the sliced bananas and chopped pecans. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Serve immediately.
description: On Sunday mornings, these plump vegan pancakes, created in collaboration with SILK®, satisfy your cravings for both crepes and cinnamon buns. Made with simple ingredients, like unsweetened oat milk that gives them their moistness, they’re perfect to treat everyone.

title: Porchetta and Asparagus Croque Madame with Cheddar Mornay Sauce
recipeIngredients: 1 tbsp butter ; 1 tbsp unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 cup (250 ml) milk; 1 cup (100 g) sharp cheddar cheese, grated ; 1	egg yolk ; 1	pinch ground nutmeg; 4	slices square brioche bread; 5 oz (170 g) porchetta or white ham, thinly sliced ; 1 lb (450 g) asparagus, trimmed and blanched ; 1 ¼ cups (125 g) sharp cheddar cheese, grated; 1 tbsp butter; 4 eggs; 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 1 tbsp (15 ml) apple cider vinegar ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) honey; 2 tsp (10 ml) whole-grain mustard; 6 cups (140 g) mesclun lettuce (see note); 3	radishes, various colours, thinly sliced on a mandoline
recipeInstructions: In a pot over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the flour and cook for 1 minute while whisking. Add the milk. Bring to a boil while whisking constantly. Cook for another 2 minutes or until the mixture thickens. Remove from the heat.; Add the cheese, egg yolk and nutmeg. Season with salt and pepper. Mix just until the cheese has melted.; With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.; Place the bread slices on the baking sheet. Cover each slice with 2 tbsp (30 ml) of the Mornay sauce. Top with the sliced porchetta and asparagus. Add the remaining Mornay sauce and sprinkle with the cheese (see note). Bake for 15 minutes or until the cheese is nicely browned.; Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk together the oil, vinegar, honey and mustard. Season with salt and pepper. When ready to serve, add the mesclun and radishes. Mix well.; In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, melt the butter. Carefully crack the eggs directly into the skillet and cook, on one side only, for 3 minutes or until the whites are set. Season with salt and pepper.; Using a spatula, place one egg over each slice of baked bread. Serve with the salad. Serve immediately.
description: Croque madame is an essential brunch dish. Inspired by the one we serve at Café RICARDO restaurants, this gourmet version is even more decadent than the original. As all the steps can be done in advance, it's the ideal dish for entertaining at home. All you have to do is assemble and reheat your croque madame and cook the eggs at the last minute.

title: Vegan Strawberry Scones
recipeIngredients: 3/4 cup (180 ml) unsweetened oat beverage (see note), plus more for brushing ; 2 tsp (10 ml) lemon juice; 2 cups (300 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1/2 cup (105 g) sugar; 1 tsp baking powder; 1/2 tsp baking soda; 1/2 tsp salt; 1/2 cup (115 g) virgin coconut oil (see note); 1 cup (140 g) fresh strawberries, cut into small wedges; 1/2 cup (65 g) icing sugar; 1 lemon, zest finely grated; 1 tbsp (15 ml) lemon juice
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the top third, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.; In a bowl, combine the oat beverage and lemon juice. Let sit for 5 minutes.; In a food processor or in a large bowl with a pastry cutter, combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Add the coconut oil and blend until the mixture has a sandy texture.; Add the oat beverage mixture and combine just until the dry ingredients are moistened. Do not overwork the dough.; On a floured work surface, form the dough into a 12-inch (30 cm) square using your fingers or a rolling pin. Cover with the strawberries. Loosely roll the dough up into a long log. Gently press the dough into a rectangle about 1 ¼ inch (3.5 cm) thick. Cut the dough into 5 rectangles. Cut each rectangle in half to form two triangles. Place the scones on the baking sheet, evenly spacing them out. Freeze at this point, if desired (see note). Brush the scones with more oat beverage.; Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until the scones are golden. Let cool on a wire rack.; In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients until smooth. Add more lemon juice as needed. Top the scones with the icing.
description: Scones and butter seem to be inseparable. And yet, we’ve managed to create a vegan recipe that uses no dairy products and that’s just as scrumptious as the original recipe. Our secret ingredients? An oat beverage and coconut oil. Thanks to them, you’ll get crumbly, golden scones just as you like them.

title: Herb and Asparagus Omelette
recipeIngredients: 3/4 cup (180 ml) water; 1/4 lb (115 g) medium asparagus, trimmed and cut into pieces ¾ inch (2 cm) long ; 6 eggs; 2 tbsp butter ; 3 tbsp mixed herbs, finely chopped (such as chives, flat-leaf parsley, dill, tarragon) ; 2 tbsp firm washed-rind cheese shavings (such as Louis d’Or)
recipeInstructions: In a large non-stick skillet over high heat, bring the water and asparagus to a boil. Cook for 3 minutes or until the water is almost completely evaporated and the asparagus is tender. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside on a plate. Wipe out the skillet.; Meanwhile, in a bowl, whisk the eggs. Season with salt and pepper.; In the same skillet over medium heat, melt the butter until foaming. Pour in the eggs. Cook the omelette for 2 to 3 minutes, breaking up the eggs, using a wooden or plastic spatula, to ensure even cooking. Arrange the asparagus in a strip down the centre of the omelette. Spread the herbs over the entire surface of the omelette. ; Reduce the heat to medium-low and continue to cook for 2 minutes or until the omelette begins to set around the edges. Fold two opposite sides of the omelette over the strip of asparagus. Cook for another 2 minutes or until the omelette is just slightly runny. Cut in half using the spatula.; Serve the omelette on plates. Top with the cheese shavings. Serve immediately.
description: For a simple gourmet breakfast, make this omelette using a generous quantity of fresh herbs and asparagus. Cook it until it’s slightly runny and add some cheese shavings as a finishing touch.

title: Greek Yogurt with Crunchy Granola and Caramelized Pineapple
recipeIngredients: 1/2 cup (125 ml) 0% plain Greek yogurt (see note); 1/2 cup (125 ml) maple syrup; 1/4 cup (60 ml) vegetable oil; 1 tsp ground cinnamon or vanilla ; 1 1/2 cups (150 g) large-flake oats ; 1 1/2 cups (150 g) quick-cooking oats ; 1/2 cup (125 ml) maple syrup; 290 g cups (290 g) pineapple, diced; 2 cups (500 ml) 0% plain Greek yogurt
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.; In a bowl, combine the yogurt, maple syrup, oil and cinnamon. Add the oats and mix well. Let sit for 5 minutes in order for the liquid to be soaked up by the oats. Spread the mixture out on the baking sheet.; Bake for 25 minutes. Gently flip the granola over. Bake for another 5 minutes or until the granola is nicely browned. Let cool completely, about 1 hour. The granola will keep for 1 month in an airtight container at room temperature.; Meanwhile, in a small pot, bring the syrup to a boil. Simmer until light amber, about 4 minutes. Add the pineapple and cook until slightly tender and the syrup is slightly thickened, about 8 to 9 minutes. Transfer into a bowl and let cool. Cover and refrigerate. The caramelized pineapple will keep for 1 week.; For each serving, when ready to serve, pour about 1 tbsp (15 ml) of the pineapple cooking syrup into the bottom of a glass or jar. Add 1/3 cup (75 ml) of the yogurt. Top with about 2 tbsp of the caramelized pineapple and granola, to taste.
description: Greek Yogurt with Crunchy Granola and Caramelized Pineapple

title: Greek Yogurt with Caramelized Peanut Granola Clusters and Berries
recipeIngredients: 1/4 cup (60 ml) vegetable oil; 1/4 cup (60 ml) molasses; 1/4 cup (55 g) brown sugar; 1 egg white; 3 cups (300 g) large-flake oats ; 1 cup (150 g) roasted salted peanuts; 2 cups (270 g) mixed fresh berries (such as blueberries, blackberries, raspberries) ; 6 tbsp (90 ml) raspberry or mixed berry jam ; 2 cups (500 ml) 0% plain Greek yogurt (see note)
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.; In a large bowl, whisk together the oil, molasses, brown sugar and egg white. Add the oats and peanuts. Mix to coat the oats well. Spread out on the baking sheet.; Bake for 15 minutes. Gently flip the granola over. Bake for another 5 to 10 minutes or until the granola is caramelized. Let cool completely, about 1 hour. The granola should clump together in pieces of varying sizes. Break the larger pieces, as needed. The granola will keep for 1 month in an airtight container at room temperature.; For each serving, when ready to serve, in a bowl, combine 1/3 cup (45 g) of the berries with 1 tbsp (15 ml) of the jam. Place some of this berry mixture at the bottom of a glass or jar. Add 1/3 cup (75 ml) of the yogurt. Top with the remaining berry mixture and granola, to taste.
description: Greek Yogurt with Caramelized Peanut Granola Clusters and Berries

title: Greek Yogurt with Cinnamon Granola and Confit Apples
recipeIngredients: 3 cups (300 g) large-flake oats ; 1 cup (100 g) pecans, chopped; 6 tbsp (80 g) unsalted butter; 3 tbsp brown sugar; 3 tbsp (45 ml) maple syrup; 1 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon; 1 tsp ground ginger ; 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg ; 1 cup (250 ml) water; 1/2 cup (105 g) sugar; 1 tbsp (15 ml) lemon juice; 2 small Cortland apples, unpeeled, cored and cut into wedges 1/2 inch (1 cm) thick ; 2 cups (500 ml) 0% plain Greek yogurt (see note)
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.; In a large bowl, combine the oats and pecans.; In a small pot, melt the butter with the brown sugar, maple syrup and spices. Pour into the bowl with the oats and mix well. Spread out on the baking sheet.; Bake for 25 minutes, stirring three times during cooking. Let cool completely, about 1 hour. The granola will keep for 1 month in an airtight container at room temperature.; Meanwhile, in a pot, bring the water, sugar and lemon juice to a boil just until the sugar has dissolved. Add the apples and simmer over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes or until tender and slightly translucent. Remove from the heat. Let sit for 15 minutes without stirring. Transfer into an airtight container and let cool. Cover and refrigerate. The apples will keep for 1 week.; For each serving, when ready to serve, pour about 1 tbsp (15 ml) of the apple cooking syrup into the bottom of a glass or jar. Add 1/3 cup (75 ml) of the yogurt. Top with apples, apple cooking syrup and granola, to taste.

title: Eggs Florentine
recipeIngredients: 1 tbsp butter; 1 tsp unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 cup (250 ml) milk; 1 cup (100 g) Gruyère cheese, grated; 1 egg yolk; 1 pinch ground nutmeg; 1 shallot, finely chopped; 2  tbsp butter; 1/4 cup (60 ml) 35% cream; 13 cups (310 g) baby spinach; 1 tbsp (15 ml) white vinegar; 4 eggs
recipeInstructions: In a small pot over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the flour and cook for 1 minute while whisking. Add the milk. Bring to a boil, whisking continuously. Cook for another 2 minutes or until the sauce thickens. Off the heat, add the cheese, egg yolk and nutmeg. Season with salt and pepper. Stir until the cheese has melted. Cover and keep warm.; In a large skillet over medium-high heat, soften the shallot in the butter. Pour in the cream and let reduce by half. Add the spinach and cook for 1 minute or until wilted. Season with salt and pepper. Keep warm.; In a pot of salted simmering water, add the vinegar. Break the eggs into small ramequins and slide them into the water one at a time. Poach for 2 to 3 minutes or until the yolks are runny and the whites are cooked through but still soft. Drain the eggs on paper towel.; Divide the creamed spinach among 4 plates. Top with the eggs and drizzle with the mornay sauce. Caramelize the sauce with a kitchen torch, if desired. Serve with toast.
description: Brunch lovers will delight in this classic egg dish. Poached eggs are covered in mornay sauce (a cheesy Gruyère bechamel sauce) and served on a bed of creamed spinach. Look out, eggs benedict, this dish is raising brunch to the next level.

title: Mushroom Toasts with Porcini Mayonnaise
recipeIngredients: 2 packages (14 g each) dried porcini or bolete mushrooms, finely chopped ; 1/2 cup (125 ml) warm water; 1/3 cup (75 ml) mayonnaise; 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) lemon juice; 1/2 lb (225 g) white mushrooms, sliced; 5 oz (140 g) white or brown shimeji mushrooms, stems trimmed (see note) ; 1 garlic clove, finely chopped; 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil; 2 tbsp chives, finely chopped ; 1/2 ciabatta baguette, cut in half horizontally, each half cut into 2 pieces ; 1/2 lb (225 g) asparagus, trimmed ; 4 hard-boiled eggs, cut into small wedges; 1 lemon, quartered
recipeInstructions: Place the porcini mushrooms in a bowl. Cover with the water and let soak for 30 minutes at room temperature.; Place a fine sieve over a bowl. Drain the mushrooms in the sieve, pressing down with the back of a spoon to extract as much water as possible. Set the soaking water aside.; In a small food processor, purée half of the porcini mushrooms with the mayonnaise and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper. Set the remaining porcini mushrooms aside.; In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook the white mushrooms, shimeji mushrooms and garlic in 2 tbsp (30 ml) of the oil until golden. Add the reserved porcini mushrooms and soaking water. Continue to cook until the water has evaporated. Add the chives. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Set aside.; Preheat the grill, setting the burners to high, or heat a ridged skillet over high heat.; Brush the pieces of bread and the asparagus with the remaining oil. Grill the bread and asparagus for 5 minutes or until the bread is golden and the asparagus is al dente. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside on a plate.; Spread the porcini mayonnaise over the pieces of grilled bread. Top with the grilled asparagus and the mushroom mixture. Garnish with the eggs. Season the eggs with salt and pepper. Serve with the lemon wedges.

title: Homemade Crispy Rice Cereal

title: Japanese Soufflé Pancakes
recipeIngredients: 1/4 cup (40 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1/2 tsp baking powder ; 1/4 tsp salt ; 2 eggs, at room temperature and separated; 2 tbsp (30 ml) milk; 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) vanilla; 2 tbsp sugar; Butter, softened, for cooking; 1 tbsp (15 ml) water

title: Brunch Lasagna
recipeIngredients: 3	eggs; 3 tbsp unbleached all-purpose flour ; 1	pinch salt; ¾ cup (180 ml) water; Softened butter, for cooking; 8	breakfast sausages, casings removed; 1	red bell pepper, seeded and diced ; 8	eggs ; 1 tbsp butter ; 1	broccoli, cut into small florets, blanched and cooled; 5	slices cooked bacon, diced; 3 cups (300 g) cheddar cheese, grated; Chives, finely chopped, to taste ; 3 tbsp (45 ml) water; 1 tbsp (15 ml) white wine vinegar; 3	egg yolks; ¾ cup (170 g) unsalted butter, melted
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, flour and salt. Add the water and whisk until smooth. If the mixture is too liquid, add a small amount of flour.; Heat an 8-inch (20 cm) non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, brush with butter.; For each crepe, pour about ¼ cup (60 ml) of the batter in the centre of the skillet. Tilt the skillet from side to side to spread the batter evenly to cover the bottom of the skillet. Once bubbles start to form on the surface and the edge of the crepe easily comes away from the skillet, after about 1 minute, flip the crepe over using a spatula. Cook for another 30 seconds and remove from the skillet. Set aside on a plate.; In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, cook the sausage meat, breaking it up with a wooden spoon. Set aside on another plate.; In the same skillet, cook the bell pepper until starting to brown. Set aside with the sausage meat. Clean out the skillet.; In another bowl, whisk the eggs. Season with salt and pepper.; In the clean skillet over medium heat, melt the butter. Pour in the eggs and cook, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon or a spatula, for 3 minutes or until just cooked. Remove from the heat. Adjust the seasoning.; In a bowl ready for a double boiler, off the heat, whisk together the water, vinegar and egg yolks. Place over a pot of simmering water and whisk until the texture becomes thick and frothy. Do not overcook the mixture so as not to scramble the egg yolks.; Remove the bowl from the double boiler. Off the heat, drizzle in the melted butter, whisking constantly. Season with salt and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap directly on the surface of the sauce. Keep warm.; With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).; In a 13 x 9-inch (33 x 23 cm) baking dish, place two crepes side-by-side. Cover with ½ cup (125 ml) of the hollandaise. Add half of the broccoli, sausage meat, bell pepper, bacon and eggs. Sprinkle with 1 cup (100 g) of the cheese. Repeat this step, then finish off with 2 crepes and the remaining cheese. Reserve the remaining hollandaise sauce for serving.; Bake for 20 minutes. Broil for 2 to 3 minutes or until the cheese is golden.; Serve the brunch lasagna on plates. Drizzle with the remaining hollandaise to taste and sprinkle with chives.
description: Brunch Lasagna

title: Burrata, Roasted Tomato and Fried Egg Toasts
recipeIngredients: 2 cups (280 g) cherry tomatoes, various colours, halved ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil; 1 tbsp (15 ml) honey; 1 tbsp (15 ml) white wine vinegar; ¼ tsp salt ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil; 4	eggs; 4	slices country bread, grilled ; 1	garlic clove, halved; 1	burrata (250 g), at room temperature, drained and torn into pieces ; 2 tbsp chives, cut into ½-inch (1.5 cm) pieces ; Fleur de sel; Red pepper flakes (optional)
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.; In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Season with pepper. Let marinate for 5 minutes. Drain well.; Place the tomatoes, cut side up, on the baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes or until the tomatoes start to soften and are lightly browned.; Meanwhile, in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high, heat the oil until lightly simmering (see note). Carefully crack the eggs directly into the skillet and cook, on one side only, for 2 to 3 minutes or until the whites are set and the edges are golden and crispy.; Rub the grilled bread with the garlic clove. Top the bread with the burrata and tomatoes. Sprinkle with the chives. Place a fried egg on each toast. Sprinkle with fleur de sel and red pepper flakes, if desired.

title: Lobster Croque Monsieur
recipeIngredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter; 2 tbsp unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 cup (250 ml) milk; 1 pinch nutmeg; 4 thick slices white bread, lightly toasted ; 1 lobster (1 lb/450 g), cooked and shelled (see note) ; 4 oz (115 g) Pied-de-Vent, Riopelle or Sauvagine cheese, sliced; Fresh chives, finely chopped, to taste
recipeInstructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Whisk in the milk and bring to a boil, whisking constantly. Simmer gently for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and add the nutmeg. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside. ; With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. ; Place the bread slices on the baking sheet. Spread a little béchamel on each slice and cover with lobster and cheese. Drizzle with béchamel and season with salt. ; Bake for 6 to 8 minutes or until the béchamel is lightly browned and the cheese is melted. Sprinkle with chives, if desired.

title: Oatmeal and Dried Fruit Confit with Orange Juice
recipeIngredients: ½ cup (100 g) dried apricots, quartered ; ¼ cup (40 g) dried cranberries; ½ cup (125 ml) orange juice; 2 cups (500 ml) unsweetened oat beverage; 1 cup (100 g) quick-cooking oats ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) maple syrup; 1	pinch ground cinnamon; 2 tbsp (30 ml) natural peanut butter (see note); 1	small orange, peeled and cut into skinless segments, and the segments cut into pieces ; 2 tbsp pumpkin seeds
recipeInstructions: In a small pot over medium-high heat, bring the dried fruits and orange juice to a boil. Simmer for 5 minutes or until the liquid has almost completely evaporated. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and let cool.; In another pot, bring the oat beverage, oats, maple syrup and cinnamon to a boil while stirring constantly. Simmer for 1 minute. Remove from the heat and let sit for 2 minutes. Adjust the consistency with more oat beverage, as needed; Serve the oatmeal in bowls. Top with the peanut butter, dried fruits, orange pieces and pumpkin seeds.

title: Asparagus Milk Crepes
recipeIngredients: 1 ¼ cups (165 g) asparagus trimmings, thinly sliced (see note); 1 tbsp butter, plus more for cooking ; 2 cups (500 ml) milk; 3 eggs; 1 ⅓ cups (200 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 2 tsp sugar ; ½ tsp salt
recipeInstructions: In a pot over medium heat, cook the asparagus trimmings in the butter for 2 minutes while stirring. Add the milk. Bring to a boil making sure the milk does not boil over. Simmer over medium-low heat for 3 minutes or until the asparagus are tender.; In a blender, purée the milk and asparagus into a smooth liquid. Strain through a sieve placed over a bowl. Compost the pulp. Place the bowl in an ice bath to chill the milk, about 15 minutes.; In another bowl, whisk together the eggs with half of the chilled asparagus milk. Whisk in the flour, sugar and salt until smooth. Add the remaining asparagus milk.; Heat a 10 ½-inch (26 cm) non-stick crepe pan over medium-high heat. Once the pan is hot, brush with butter.; Pour about ⅓ cup (75 ml) of the crepe batter into the centre of the pan. Tilt the pan from side to side to spread the batter evenly and to cover the entire bottom of the pan. Cook the crepe for 1 minute or until the edges begin to brown. Flip over using a spatula. Cook for another 30 seconds. Set aside on a plate. Cover. Repeat with the remaining batter.

title: Green Shakshuka
recipeIngredients: 8 cups (760 g) leeks, thinly sliced ; 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 2	garlic cloves, chopped; 1 tsp ground cumin; 1 cup (250 ml) chicken broth; 4 cups (100 g) baby spinach; 1 cup (45 g) mixed herbs, finely chopped (such as dill, mint, parsley, basil and cilantro) ; 4 to 8	eggs (see note); 1 ½ tsp (7.5 ml) harissa; 1 ½ tsp (7.5 ml) lemon juice; 1 ½ tsp (7.5 ml) water ; 1	green onion, chopped
recipeInstructions: In a large non-stick skillet over medium-low heat, soften the leeks in the oil without browning until tender, about 10 minutes. Add the garlic and cumin. Cook for 1 minute while stirring.; Add the broth and let reduce by half. Add the spinach and three-quarters of the herbs. Season with salt and pepper. Cook while stirring just until the spinach has wilted, about 2 minutes.; Using a spoon, make 4 to 8 wells in the vegetable mixture. Break an egg into each well. Cover and let simmer gently for 7 to 8 minutes or until the egg whites are set but the yolks are still runny. Season the eggs with salt.; Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the harissa, lemon juice and water. Just before serving, top the eggs with the harissa mixture, to taste. Sprinkle with the remaining herbs and the green onion. Serve with grilled bread and the remaining harissa mixture, if desired.

title: Chocolate Pancakes with Spiced Pears and Miso Caramel
recipeIngredients: 1 cup (210 g) sugar; ¼ cup (60 ml) water; ½ cup (125 ml) 35% cream, hot; ¼ cup (55 g) unsalted butter, diced; 2 tbsp (30 ml) miso; 1 cup (250 ml) cold water ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) lemon juice; ½ cup (105 g) sugar; 1	piece fresh ginger, about 1 inch (2.5 cm) long; 1	cinnamon stick, about 4 inches (10 cm) long ; 2	star anise; 3	pears, ripe but firm; ¾ cup (115 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; ¼ cup (25 g) cocoa powder, sifted; 2 tbsp sugar; 1 tsp baking powder; ¼ tsp baking soda; ¼ tsp salt ; ¾ cup (180 ml) buttermilk, cold; 2 tbsp butter, melted, plus more for cooking ; 1	egg, yolk and white separated; ½ cup (125 ml) mascarpone cheese, softened; ¼ cup (45 g) roasted almonds, roughly chopped; 2 tbsp roasted white and black sesame seeds
recipeInstructions: In a pot, bring the sugar and water to a boil. Cook without stirring until the mixture is golden. Remove from the heat. Gradually add the cream. Watch out for splattering.; Bring the mixture back to a boil just until smooth. Add the butter and mix until melted. Remove from the heat. Add the miso and whisk until smooth. Transfer to a bowl and let cool.; In a large skillet, combine the water, lemon juice, sugar, ginger, cinnamon and star anise. Bring to a boil just until the sugar has dissolved.; Meanwhile, on a work surface, peel the pears and cut in half lengthwise. Using a melon baller, remove the core from each pear half. Cut each pear half into four pieces lengthwise.; Add the pears to the hot syrup and simmer over medium heat for 8 minutes or until tender. Let cool in the syrup. Drain before serving (see note).; In a large bowl, combine the flour, cocoa powder, half of the sugar, the baking powder, baking soda and salt. Set aside. ; In a small bowl or in a measuring cup, combine the buttermilk with the melted butter and egg yolk. Set aside.; In a third bowl, whisk the egg white using an electric mixer until frothy. Gradually add the remaining sugar and whisk until semi-stiff peaks form.; Add the buttermilk mixture to the dry ingredients. Mix with a spatula just until the dry ingredients are moistened. Using a spatula, delicately fold in the meringue. Let the batter sit for 10 minutes.; In a large non-stick skillet or crepe pan brushed with butter, over medium-low heat, cook 3 to 4 pancakes at a time using 3 tbsp (45 ml) of the batter for each one, spreading them out slightly. Once the pancakes are nicely browned on one side and bubbles start to form on the uncooked surface, after about 3 minutes, gently flip them over with a spatula. Cook until the second side is golden and the pancakes are cooked through, about 1 minute.; Serve the pancakes on plates. Top with the mascarpone and pears. Drizzle generously with the caramel. Sprinkle with almonds and sesame seeds.
description: Chocolate Pancakes with Spiced Pears and Miso Caramel

title: Vegan Maple Baked Beans
recipeIngredients: 2 ¼ cups (450 g) dry white beans or navy beans (see note); 1	onion, chopped; 1 tbsp (15 ml) vegetable oil; 6 cups (1.5 litres) cold water; ½ cup (125 ml) maple syrup; 1 tbsp (15 ml) molasses; 1 tsp (5 ml) Dijon mustard; 1 tsp salt ; ½ tsp ground black pepper
recipeInstructions: Place the beans in a large bowl. Cover with cold water and let soak for 12 hours or overnight at room temperature. Add water, as needed, so the beans are always well covered. Rinse and drain.; With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C).; In a Dutch oven over medium-high heat, soften the onion in the oil. Add the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Cover and bake for 4 hours. Remove from the oven. Stir. Cover and let sit for 15 minutes to allow the sauce to thicken. Adjust the seasoning.

title: Chocolate-Banana Waffle Toast
recipeIngredients: 4	slices white sandwich bread, crusts removed ; ¼ cup (60 ml) mayonnaise; 2 tbsp sugar ; Chocolate-hazelnut spread, to taste ; 1	banana, cut into rounds; Ground nutmeg, to taste
recipeInstructions: Preheat a waffle iron on high. Use a pastry brush to lightly oil the cavities.; On a work surface, cover both sides of the bread slices with the mayonnaise, then sprinkle with the sugar.; Place the bread in the waffle iron. Close the device. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until the bread is golden and caramelized.; Cover the bread with the chocolate-hazelnut spread. Top with the banana slices and sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Cranberry-Cinnamon Brioche Wreath
recipeIngredients: ½ cup (125 ml) warm water; 1 ½ tsp instant yeast; 3 ¼ cups (490 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; ¼ cup (55 g) sugar; 1 ½ tsp salt ; ⅓ cup (75 ml) milk ; 2	eggs ; ½ cup (115 g) unsalted butter, softened and diced ; 1 cup (105 g) fresh or frozen cranberries ; ½ cup (105 g) sugar ; ¼ cup (60 ml) water; 2	cinnamon sticks, each about 4 inches (10 cm) long (see note); 1 tsp cane sugar (optional)
recipeInstructions: In a small bowl, combine the water and yeast. Let sit for 5 minutes to rehydrate and dissolve the yeast. ; In a stand mixer fitted with the dough hook, combine 3 cups (450 g) of the flour with the sugar and salt. Add the yeast mixture, milk and eggs. Mix for 5 minutes. With the machine running, gradually add the butter. Mix in the remaining flour to bring the dough together. Place the dough in a clean, lightly oiled bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight.; Meanwhile, in a small pot, bring the cranberries, sugar, water and cinnamon sticks to a boil. Let simmer over medium-low heat for 10 minutes or until the syrup coats the back of a spoon. Transfer to a bowl. Cover and let cool at room temperature. Remove the cinnamon sticks. Using a fork, mash half of the cranberries. ; Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper. Butter the outside of a 4-inch (10 cm) ovenproof bowl and place upside-down at the centre of the baking sheet. ; On a floured work surface, roll the dough into a 20 x 12-inch (50 x 30 cm) rectangle. Spread the cranberry filling over the entire surface of the dough using a spatula. Starting with one of the long sides, loosely roll the dough up into a long cylinder. Arrange the rolled dough seam-side up. ; Cut the dough in half lengthwise following along the seam line, leaving 1 inch (2.5 cm) of dough intact at one end. Twist the two strands of dough together, keeping the filling side up. Place the twist of dough on the prepared baking sheet around the bowl. Bring the two ends together into a wreath shape. Thread one strand of dough through the centre and the other strand underneath the uncut end, folding them together under the wreath to seal.; Cover with a damp dishcloth and let rise at room temperature for 45 minutes or until doubled in volume. ; With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Sprinkle the brioche with the cane sugar, if desired.; Bake for 25 minutes or until golden. Let cool on a wire rack (see note).
description: Cranberry-Cinnamon Brioche Wreath

title: Carrot Cake Jam on Toast
recipeIngredients: 1 cup (130 g) carrots, cut into rounds ¼ inch (5 mm) thick ; 1 ½ cups (220 g) pineapple, cut into small dice	; ¾ cup (160 g) sugar; 1	lemon, zest and juice ; 1	cinnamon stick, 2 inches (5 cm) long ; ½ tsp ground ginger ; 1	pinch ground nutmeg; 4	slices nut and raisin bread, lightly toasted (see note); Cream cheese, softened, to taste ; 2 tbsp roasted pecans, chopped (optional)
recipeInstructions: In a pot of boiling water, cook the carrots for 15 minutes or until tender. Drain. In a small food processor, finely chop the carrots.; In the same pot over medium heat, combine the carrots, pineapple, sugar, lemon zest and juice, and the spices. Cook for 20 minutes or until the jam thickens. Let cool. Remove and compost the cinnamon stick. Transfer the jam into an airtight container. Let cool. Cover and refrigerate. The jam will keep for 2 weeks in the refrigerator.; Spread the slices of toasted bread with cream cheese. Top each piece of bread with 2 tbsp (30 ml) of the jam. Sprinkle with pecans, if desired.

title: French Omelette (The Best)

recipeInstructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Whisk with a fork for 2 minutes or until smooth with no traces of egg white remaining. ; In an 8-inch (20 cm) non-stick skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter without letting it brown.; Pour the eggs into the skillet, whisking constantly with a spatula until the mixture is starting to set, about 1 minute.; Once the eggs are almost dry but still creamy, reduce the heat. Tilt the skillet to slide the eggs to one side. Using a spatula, roll the omelette into a log. Tilt the skillet again, rolling the omelette onto a plate. The centre of the omelette should still be runny. Using a pastry brush, cover the omelette with butter and sprinkle with chives, if desired.

title: Double Chocolate Waffles
recipeIngredients: 1 ½ cups (225 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; ½ cup (50 g) cocoa powder, sifted; ½ tsp baking soda ; ½ tsp salt ; 2	eggs; 1/3 cup (70 g) brown sugar ; 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla ; 1/3 cup (75 ml) canola oil; 4 oz (115 g) milk or dark chocolate, chopped; 1 ½ cups (375 ml) buttermilk
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda and salt. ; In another bowl, whisk the eggs, brown sugar and vanilla with an electric mixer for 5 minutes or until pale, forms a ribbon and triples in volume. Gradually whisk in the oil. Using a spatula, fold in the dry ingredients and chocolate alternating with the buttermilk until everything is moistened (a few lumps of flour will remain). Let the batter rest for 10 minutes.; Preheat a waffle iron. Pour about 1/3 cup (75 ml) of the batter into each cavity. Close the machine. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until the waffles are cooked through. Keep warm. Repeat with the remaining batter.; Serve the waffles with vanilla yogurt and Black Cherry Compote, if desired.

title: Breakfast Sandwich
recipeIngredients: 1	egg; 1 tsp chives, finely chopped (optional); ½ 	slice cheddar cheese; 1	English muffin, halved horizontally and lightly toasted ; Mayonnaise, to taste; 1	leaf lettuce, thinly sliced; ½ 	slice ham; 1 tbsp chorizo, cut into small dice ; 1	slice tomato; Hot sauce, to taste
recipeInstructions: Crack the egg into a 3 ¾-inch (9.5 cm) wide ramekin and add the chives, if desired. Season with salt and pepper. Whisk with a fork.; Place the ramekin in the microwave oven. Cover with a small plate and cook for 30 seconds. Place the cheese over the egg and cook, uncovered, for 10 seconds or until the egg is cooked.; Cover the inside of the English muffin with mayonnaise. Add the lettuce and omelette. Add a topping, if desired.

title: Huevos Rancheros with Black Beans on the Grill
recipeIngredients: 3 cups (420 g) cherry tomatoes; 1	serrano or jalapeño chili pepper, seeded and coarsely chopped; 1	onion, chopped; 1	yellow bell pepper, seeded and diced; 2	garlic cloves, chopped; 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 1 tsp dried oregano ; ½ tsp ground cumin ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) red wine vinegar; 1	can (19 oz/540 ml) black beans, rinsed and drained; 4	eggs ; 2/3 cup (80 g) feta cheese, crumbled; Cilantro leaves, to taste; 1	ripe avocado, diced
recipeInstructions: Place a 10-inch (25 cm) wide, 2-inch (5 cm) deep cast iron pan directly on the barbecue grill. Preheat the grill, setting the burners to medium.; Place the tomatoes and chili pepper in the hot, dry skillet. Close the barbecue lid and cook until the tomatoes burst and release their juices, about 8 minutes, stirring twice. Set aside in a bowl.; In the same skillet, soften the onion, bell pepper and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes, stirring with a wooden spoon. Add the oregano and cumin. Cook for 1 minute while stirring. Add the vinegar, black beans and two-thirds of the tomato mixture. Season with salt and pepper.; Using a spoon, make 4 wells in the mixture and break an egg into each one. Close the barbecue lid and cook for 6 minutes or until the egg whites are cooked but the yolks are still runny. Remove the skillet from the barbecue.; Season the eggs with salt and pepper. Garnish with the remaining tomato mixture, the feta, cilantro and avocado, if desired. Serve with grilled soft corn tortillas, if desired.
description: Huevos Rancheros with Black Beans on the Grill

title: Buckwheat Crepes with Sparkling Water
recipeIngredients: 1 cup (150 g) buckwheat flour; ½ cup (75 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; ¼ tsp salt ; 2	eggs; 2 cups (500 ml) sparkling water ; 2 tbsp melted butter, plus more for cooking ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) maple syrup, plus more for serving; 3	Empire apples, seeded and cut into ½-inch (1 cm) rounds; 3 tbsp (45 ml) maple syrup; 1 tbsp butter
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine both flours with the salt. Add the eggs, 1 cup (250 ml) of the sparkling water and the melted butter. Whisk well until smooth. Add the remaining sparkling water and the maple syrup.; Heat a 7-inch (18 cm) non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, brush it with butter.; For each crepe, pour about ¼ cup (60 ml) of the batter in the centre of the skillet. Tilt the skillet from side to side to spread the batter evenly to cover the bottom of the skillet. Once the edge of the crepe easily comes away from the skillet and starts to brown, after about 1 minute, flip the crepe over using a spatula. Cook for another 30 seconds and remove from the skillet. Set aside on a plate.; In another large skillet over high heat, brown half of the apple slices at a time on both sides in the maple syrup and butter.; Serve the crepes with the caramelized apples or berries. Add more maple syrup, if desired.
description: Buckwheat Crepes with Sparkling Water
